title: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion
definition: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion is God's freeing of believers from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
summary: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion teaches that believers are freed from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ died and rose so His people would no longer be enslaved to sin.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Deliverance from sin's dominion means believers are no longer ruled by sin as their master. Scripture teaches that salvation does not only forgive guilt; it also breaks sin's enslaving authority over those united to Christ.

This does not mean believers never struggle. It means the old master no longer owns them, and sin no longer has the final claim on their identity, future, or obedience.

Christ died and rose so His people could walk in newness of life. Freedom from sin's dominion is rooted not in human willpower but in the believer's union with the crucified and risen Lord.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many believers either excuse bondage as normal or despair because they still feel the pull of old sins. This doctrine gives sober hope: sin is still an enemy, but it is no longer king in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Name the sins that try to rule you, and bring them under the truth of the cross and resurrection. Resist with Scripture, confession, prayer, wise accountability, and practical obedience, remembering that you fight from freedom in Christ, not for freedom apart from Him.
